title: Bruno Sammartino: the first great reign
summary: Bruno takes the championship from Buddy Rogers and becomes the central hero of the WWWF. Ivan Koloff eventually ends the reign, changing the title picture overnight.

chapters.title: Bruno dethrones Buddy Rogers
chapters.result: Sammartino defeats Rogers to win the WWWF championship.
chapters.context: The first milestone of a championship era built around Bruno facing successive challengers.

chapters.title: Koloff ends Bruno’s reign
chapters.result: Ivan Koloff defeats Sammartino for the championship.
chapters.context: The loss ends more than seven years with Bruno as champion.
